The operator consists of two chain operators, a rain sensor, a power supply, a control unit and a remote. The products are manufactured by the VELUX Group at a production site in the Czech Republic.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value:
The VELUX INTEGRA GPU window operators are a mains connected ventilation system for tup-hung windows. They are made up of two chain operators, a power supply, a rain sensor and a remote. The products are assembled at a VELUX production site and are integrated with new windows. 
Technical data: 
The CE marking for electrical window operators does not specify the need for a Declaration of Performance. Instead, a Declaration of Conformity is required.
The performance values relevant for the product are specified in the table below. 
Declared unit: 
The declared unit is one piece. This corresponds to an electrical window operator system, including two chain operators, a power supply, a rain sensor, a control unit and a remote.

Die VELUX INTEGRA GPU Fensterantriebe sind ein netzbetriebenes Lüftungssystem für Kippfenster. Sie bestehen aus zwei Kettenantrieben, einer Stromversorgung, einem Regensensor und einer Fernbedienung. Die Produkte werden in einer VELUX Produktionsstätte zusammengebaut und in neue Fenster integriert. 
Technische Daten: 
Die CE-Kennzeichnung für elektrische Fensterantriebe schreibt keine Leistungserklärung vor. Stattdessen ist eine Konformitäterklärung erforderlich. 
Deklarierte Einheit: 
1 stück

technologicalApplicability.value: The VELUX electrical window operator is installed in new windows before distribution to customers.
Der elektrische VELUX Fensterantrieb wird vor der Auslieferung an die Kunden in neue Fenster eingebaut.

useAdviceForDataSet.value:
Scope: 
The EPD is a specific EPD covering VELUX electrical window operator for the mains connected top-hung window type VELUX INTEGRA GPU. The operator consists of two chain operators, a rain sensor, a power supply, a control unit and a remote. The products are manufactured by the VELUX Group at a production site in the Czech Republic. 
System boundary: 
Type of EPD:
Cradle to gate - with options. The following life cycle phases were considered:


Product stage:

A1 - Raw material supply: extraction and processing, production of the pre-products (e.g. motor suspension, polychlorinated biphenyl (PCB), battery...). Packaging is not included, since the products are integrated with the window. VELUX roof window EPD's include the packaging. An exception is a small cardboard box for one of the components.

A2 - Transport: Transport of pre-products and packaging components to the manufacturing sites

A3 - Manufacturing: The products are produced/assembled at the VELUX production site, where the finished window operator is ready for shipment.


End of life stage: 

C1 - De-construction/demolition: de-construction of the product with the use of manual hand tools.

C2 - Transport: transport of the product to waste treatment including to and from sorting and shredding facilities.

C3 - Waste processing: includes sorting, shredding, incineration and recycling processes. 

C4 - Disposal: disposal of all materials


Benefits and loads beyond the system boundaries:

D - Reuse, recovery and recycling potential: benefits from plastic incineration processes and material recycling. 
End-of-life includes all activities from when the product reaches the end of its service life and no longer provides any functionality until all materials and components are processed for reuse/recycling/energy recovery or are disposed of.

The applied end-of-life scenario follows the requirements in the PCR Part A, chapter 6.2 regarding complex products, with a combination of recycling, thermal waste treatment and landfilling. 100% of the material is considered in the end of life scenario. Generally, metals, cables, batteries and polychlorinated biphenyl (PCB)'s are recycled, plastic parts are incinerated with energy recovery and magnets are landfilled.

Gültigkeitsbereich: 
Die EPD ist spezuifisch und inkludiert ein stück elektrische Fensterantriebe verkauft in Europa 
Systemgrenze: 
Cradle to gate - mit Optionen: inkludiert die Module A1, A2, A3, C1, C2, C3, C4 und D
